• [1] In 2020, the SolarWinds IT monitoring system, Orion, was compromised by hackers, allowing them to deliver backdoor malware in an Orion software update, affecting approximately 18,000 customers. [1]
• [1] In May 2026, a TanStack npm supply chain attack compromised a former employee's account, allowing an attacker to copy about 170 private GitHub repositories. [2][3]
• [1] The TanStack npm attack also led to the theft of credentials from developers' machines, including GitHub tokens, SSH keys, and cloud credentials. [2][3]
• [1] The attack on TanStack was tracked as CVE-2026-45321, and it is believed that the malicious package reached the former employee's laptop or was used to compromise other devices. [2][3]
• [1] The attack on CrowdSec's private GitHub repositories also included the email addresses of 83 CrowdSec users and the names, email addresses, and investment context of 51 potential investors from 2020. [3]
